data.name: Manage Signup Links
data.description: Author one-click signup link configurations and generate, inspect and revoke the links produced from them. Covers: POST /iam/signup-links/configurations, PATCH /iam/signup-links/configurations/{id}, POST /iam/signup-links/configurations/{id}/archive, GET /iam/signup-links/configurations/{id}, POST /iam/signup-links/configurations/query, POST /iam/signup-links, POST /iam/signup-links/query, POST /iam/signup-links/{linkId}/revoke, POST /iam/signup-links/revoke-by-configuration, POST /iam/signup-links/summary. A configuration decides what every future link from it grants, so a holder can mint a link that creates an activated account carrying any role or permission in the tenant, without the invitee ever proving a password when the configuration is Passwordless. Generating a link returns the one-time code in the response body; the code redeems once, expires on the configuration's lifetime, and is never recoverable afterwards. Redemption itself is anonymous by design and is not covered here.

data.name: Delete Localization Key
data.description: Permanently delete a single localization key from the database. Covers: DELETE /Key/Delete?ItemId={itemId}. The key cannot be recovered; a delete entry is written to the timeline using the pre-deletion snapshot.

data.name: Delete Localization Collections
data.description: Permanently wipe every document in one or more localization MongoDB collections (BlocksLanguageKeys, BlocksLanguages, BlocksLanguageModules, UilmFiles) for the tenant. Covers: POST /Key/DeleteCollections. Hidden from the public API surface; admin/internal use only. Irreversible and destroys all localization data in the selected collections.

data.name: Delete Localization Keys in Bulk
data.description: Permanently delete multiple localization keys in one call, continuing past per-item failures. Covers: DELETE /Key/DeleteKeys. Deleted keys share one bulk-operation id in the timeline; the keys cannot be recovered.

data.name: Generate UILM File
data.description: Queue generation of a UILM language file for a module. Covers: POST /Key/GenerateUilmFile. Processed asynchronously: replaces any existing UILM files for the module and records a language-file-generation history entry. Must be called before GET /Key/GetUilmFile.

data.name: View Localization Key
data.description: Read a single localization key by its item id. Covers: GET /Key/Get?ItemId={itemId}. Read-only.

data.name: Get Localization Keys by Key Names

data.name: View UILM Generation History
data.description: Read a paginated history of UILM language-file generation runs. Covers: GET /Key/GetLanguageFileGenerationHistory?PageSize={pageSize}&PageNumber={pageNumber}. Read-only.

data.name: Search Localization Keys
data.description: Search and page through localization keys using filters such as module, translation status, missing languages, and date range. Covers: POST /Key/Gets. Read-only.

data.name: View Key Change Timeline

data.name: View Exported UILM Files

data.name: Rollback Localization Key

data.name: Save Localization Key
data.description: Create or update a single localization key and its per-language resource values. Covers: POST /Key/Save. If the key is marked to publish, a UILM file regeneration is queued and a timeline entry is recorded.

data.name: Save Localization Keys in Bulk
data.description: Create or update multiple localization keys in one call, tracked under a shared bulk-operation id in the timeline. Covers: POST /Key/SaveKeys. Keys marked to publish also queue UILM file regeneration.

data.name: Translate All Missing Keys
data.description: Queue automatic translation of every key missing a non-default-language value, optionally scoped to one module. Covers: POST /Key/TranslateAll. Processed asynchronously by calling an external AI translation service for each missing value, then bulk-saving the results.

data.name: Translate Single Key
data.description: Queue automatic translation of the missing language values for one specific localization key. Covers: POST /Key/TranslateKey. Processed asynchronously by calling the external AI translation service for the missing values.

data.name: Translate Keys in Bulk
data.description: Queue automatic translation of the missing language values for multiple localization keys, tracked under one shared operation id. Covers: POST /Key/TranslateKeys. Processed asynchronously by calling the external AI translation service for each key's missing values.

data.name: Export UILM File
data.description: Queue an export of all or selected modules and their keys to a UILM file. Covers: POST /Key/UilmExport. Processed asynchronously and writes the resulting file to storage, later listed via GetUilmExportedFiles.

data.name: Import UILM File

data.description: Allows the user to Create or update Analytics in the Trace module.

data.name: Trace Gets
data.description: Allows the user to Create or update a Trace record. Allows the user to Read a Trace record.

data.name: Provision Dependency Track User
data.description: Provision or refresh the caller's Dependency-Track (SCA) OIDC user and resolve the SCA project UUID for a build. Covers: GET /AnalyticsTool/ProcessDependencyTrackUser?buildId={buildId}. Required before software composition analysis reports can be opened for a build.

data.name: Provision SonarQube User
data.description: Provision or refresh the caller's SonarQube user and grant it access to the build's SonarQube project. Covers: GET /AnalyticsTool/ProcessSonarQubeUser?buildId={buildId}. Required before static code analysis (SAST) reports can be opened for a build.

data.name: Exchange Git Provider OAuth Code
data.description: Exchange a GitHub OAuth authorization code for an access token and store it for the caller. Covers: GET /Auth/AccessToken?code={code}. Completes the GitHub connect flow; the resulting token is persisted server-side.

data.name: View Git Provider Authorization Status
data.description: Check whether the tenant has an active GitHub OAuth authorization stored for the caller. Covers: GET /Auth/IsAuthorized. Returns status only; no token material is exposed.

data.name: Delete Stored Git Provider Token
data.description: Delete the caller's stored GitHub access token from the release database. Covers: DELETE /Auth/DeleteAuthorization. The OAuth grant at GitHub is left intact; only the locally stored token is removed.

data.name: Revoke Git Provider Authorization
data.description: Revoke the tenant's GitHub OAuth grant at the provider, disconnecting the release service from GitHub. Covers: POST /Auth/RemoveAuthorization. Automatic builds and webhooks stop working until GitHub is re-authorized.

data.name: Delete a deployed application from blocks
data.description: Allows the user to get logs data.

data.name: View Build Details
data.description: Read a single build together with the repository it was produced from. Covers: GET /Build?buildId={buildId}.

data.name: View Hosting Providers
data.description: List the hosting providers that can be selected in a repository's build settings. Covers: GET /Build/settings.

data.name: Trigger Manual Build
data.description: Trigger a build for a connected repository outside the automatic webhook pipeline. Covers: POST /Build/manual. Consumes build infrastructure and can deploy the resulting artifacts.

data.name: View Repository Details
data.description: Read a connected repository together with its build history. Covers: GET /Build/repo-details?RepoId={repoId}.

data.name: Update Repository Domain
data.description: Update the domain mapped to a connected repository's deployed application. Covers: POST /Build/repo-update. Changes the address the application is served from.

data.name: Update Repository Build Settings
data.description: Update a connected repository's build configuration, such as its branch and hosting provider. Covers: POST /Build/repo-settings-update. Affects how and where every subsequent build runs.

data.name: View Build Test Reports
data.description: Read the test and analysis reports produced by a build. Covers: GET /Build/reports?buildId={buildId}&type={type}.

data.name: View Connected Repositories
data.description: List the repositories connected to the tenant for building and deployment. Covers: GET /Build/repos-list.

data.name: Run Build
data.description: Queue a build for a connected repository on its configured branch. Covers: POST /Build/run-build. Consumes build infrastructure and can deploy the resulting artifacts.

data.name: Check GitHub Branch Exists
data.description: Verify that a connected repository's configured branch still exists on GitHub. Covers: GET /Github/GithubBranchExists?repoId={repoId}.

data.name: View GitHub Branches
data.description: List the branches of a GitHub repository reachable with the caller's OAuth token. Covers: GET /Github/branches?repo={fullRepoName}.

data.name: Clone GitHub Repository
data.description: Clone a GitHub repository into the release server workspace. Covers: GET /Github/clone?repo={fullRepoName}. Writes repository source code to the build host.

data.name: Create GitHub Repository
data.description: Create a new GitHub repository for a project that has none yet, under the connected account or one of its recorded organisations. Covers: POST /Github/repos. Repositories default to private and are created with auto_init false so the first push is a fast-forward; an organisation the stored token does not list is refused before GitHub is contacted.

data.name: Create GitHub Webhook
data.description: Register the release webhook on a connected GitHub repository so that pushes trigger automatic builds. Covers: GET /Github/CreateWebhook?RepoId={repoId}. Modifies the repository's webhook configuration on GitHub.

data.name: Read Git Push Credential
data.description: Read the caller's stored GitHub OAuth token as a git-usable HTTPS credential, for `blocks git push` and Studio's post-run push. Covers: GET /Github/credential. Returns the access token in the response body; the token does not expire until revoked and its repo scope reaches every repository the connected account can write to, not only the one being pushed. Callers must hand it to git via an askpass/credential helper for a single process and never persist it to .git/config, a remote URL or any file.

data.name: Search GitHub Repositories
data.description: Search and page through the GitHub repositories reachable with the caller's OAuth token, so they can be connected for building. Covers: GET /Github/repos?Search={search}&PageNumber={pageNumber}&PageSize={pageSize}.

data.name: View GitHub Account
data.description: Read the GitHub account profile linked to the caller's stored OAuth token. Covers: GET /Github/user.

data.name: View Repository Monitor List
data.description: Read monitor entries for a connected repository through the release API proxy. Covers: GET /api/Monitor/GetMonitorListByRepoId?ProjectKey={projectKey}&repoId={repoId}.

data.name: Secret management of a repository
data.description: Allows the user to manage secret variables and value for a repository
